topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Well, I'll be, the ol' Bailey meadow's been keepin' secrets, that's for sure. Old Tom found somethin' buried, a chest o' sorts. Beats anything I've ever clapped eyes on. Covered in symbols and wrappings, not a thing from this side of the valley, mark me. Tom says it's as heavy as a winter's heart, filled with things we can't fathom. Talk of the Saints bein' among us, but I reckon there's more to the world than our tilled earth and the chapel's bell. Maybe, just maybe, it's a message. From who, or where, I dare not think, but my hands tingle to dig deeper, to learn secrets old as the stones we plow around.
